_comment: Capability-4 composite that BAKES this bundle's own map and tables into ONE element, stacked to scroll. Both children are imported directly and compiled into the single gospel-resources bundle — no runtime injection, no second script, and no cross-bundle version skew: the tables you scroll to are built from the same pin index the map above them draws. This is the 'gospel resources dashboard' that was asked for.
label: Gospel Dashboard (map + tables baked into one element, stacked to scroll)
